title: PPG-MS13 — Reference Post Corpus & Operator Surface (resources/ ingest + setup sheet + subprogram + coolant + air-cut + probe emit)
description: Closes the value-coverage gaps surfaced by the second scrutiny pass. Ingests every generic post in H:/prism/resources/ as byte-diff reference for emission validation; wires SetupSheetPipelineEngine, SubprogramExtractionEngine, CoolantStrategyAdapter, air-cut detection, and probe emit into the post pipeline. These are existing engines/actions that today have no path to operator output.
rationale: The first scrutiny pass scored value coverage 47/100. Twelve high-value capabilities exist as engines/actions but no PPG-MS owned wiring them through to operator output. MS13 owns the gap: (a) reference-post ingest (user explicitly mentioned generic posts in resources/, plus Mastercam/Esprit reference); (b) operator-facing surfaces (setup sheet auto-gen, subprogram extraction, coolant strategy emission, air-cut rapid optimization, probe macros).
leverage_existing: SetupSheetPipelineEngine (E0423) — operator setup sheet pipeline (currently unwired to post emission)
CoolantStrategyAdapter (E0115) — TSC/MQL/flood/mist/pulse strategy (currently unwired to emit)

Existing dispatcher actions (camDispatcher): air_cut_detect, post_air_cut_detect, post_rapid_optimize, post_full_rapid_optimize, post_auto_probe, post_setup_sheet, post_setup_sheet_auto, post_setup_sheet_generate, ppg_setup_sheet, ppg_subprogram_analyze, ppg_subprogram_detect, ppg_coolant_config
Probe emit actions: probe_wcs_setup_gen, probe_first_article_gen, probe_in_process_gen, probe_tool_measure_gen, probe_auto_comp_gen

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Programmer at JM Die runs the wizard for a Holo-Krome shoulder-bolt mill job: 6 features, 3 tools, requires probing for stock variation, 4 repeating bolt-circle patterns, TSC + MQL hybrid coolant.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_ms13: Wizard emits the program but no setup sheet; programmer hand-writes one. Subprograms not extracted, so each bolt-circle is repeated inline (program 4× longer than necessary). Coolant emission defaults to flood. Probe macros copy-pasted from a previous job. Generic Mastercam reference post in resources/ is unread.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_ms13: Wizard auto-generates setup sheet (operator + tool list + coolant + workholding). SubprogramExtractionEngine collapses bolt-circle into M98 P-call (4× compression). CoolantStrategyAdapter emits TSC@200 PSI rough → MQL finish per the per-feature toggle. Probe macros emit: WCS setup, in-process touch on the critical bore, FAI on the keyway. Generated post byte-diffs cleanly against the corresponding Mastercam reference for sanity.

units.title: Reference-post corpus ingest (resources/ walk + classify + persist)
units.scope: Walk H:/prism/resources/ exhaustively. Classify .cps (Fusion), .pst (Mastercam), .mp/.mpmaster (Mastercam MP), .mcam (Mastercam X), .esp (Esprit), .post (generic). Persist into ReferencePostKnowledgeStore with vendor + controller + machine class metadata.

units.title: Byte-diff seed for MS12 from reference posts (Mastercam + Esprit)
units.scope: From U-PPGM77 ingest, select 1 reference per major dialect (Mastercam X9 sample, Esprit sample, hyperMILL sample). Emit equivalent program through PRISM master post; lock the diff baseline as a tolerated-changes manifest into MS12 corpus.

units.title: Setup sheet auto-generation from sidecar + post output
units.scope: Wire SetupSheetPipelineEngine (E0423) as PostProcessorPipelineEngine stage 35; consumes sidecar + emit output; renders operator + tool list + coolant + workholding + WCS table; available via post_setup_sheet_auto action.

units.title: Subprogram extraction wiring (M98/M99 emit for repeated patterns)
units.scope: Wire SubprogramExtractionEngine (E0440) as PostProcessorPipelineEngine stage 22; detect bolt-circle / linear-pattern / repeated-feature emissions; collapse to M98 P-call or controller-equivalent (subprogram for Fanuc, conversational repeat for Hurco).

units.title: Coolant strategy emission (TSC/MQL/flood/mist/pulse + per-feature toggle)
units.scope: Wire CoolantStrategyAdapter (E0115) into post pipeline; consume FeatureToggleMatrix from PPG-MS6; emit per-op coolant strategy (M-codes vary by controller dialect from PPG-MS5).

units.title: Air-cut detection + rapid optimization
units.scope: Wire post_air_cut_detect + post_rapid_optimize as a PostProcessorPipeline stage; replace G1 air-cuts with G0; respect machine-specific rapid override (some controllers cap at 50%); cycle-time delta logged.

units.title: Probe emit wiring (WCS / in-process / FAI / tool measure)
units.scope: Wire probe_wcs_setup_gen + probe_first_article_gen + probe_in_process_gen + probe_tool_measure_gen + probe_auto_comp_gen into post pipeline based on wizard probe-toggle; controller-specific probe macro selection from MS5 dialect emitter.

units.title: Operator surface dashboard + integration test
units.scope: End-to-end: wizard → post emit → setup sheet + subprogram + coolant + air-cut + probe → operator package (G-code + sidecar + setup sheet + probe macros + coolant ticket) zipped for download. Asserts 12 dormant engines/actions are now exercised end-to-end.

completion_criteria: resources/ tree fully ingested; ReferencePostKnowledgeStore enumerates every .cps/.pst/.mp/.mcam/.esp file with vendor + controller metadata
Byte-diff seed exists for 3 reference dialects (Mastercam, Esprit, hyperMILL)

Operator surface end-to-end test passes — generated package contains setup sheet, subprogram-compressed program, dialect-correct coolant emission, air-cut-optimized rapids, controller-specific probe macros
Subprogram compression measurable on the bolt-circle benchmark: ≥3× line-count reduction without functional change
Air-cut optimization measurable on the 50-program corpus (PPG-MS1): ≥2% cycle-time win vs no-optimization baseline
Setup sheet readable by an unfamiliar operator in <60s (UX test, N≥5 operators)
